messages.subject: shinyapps - can't seem to install
parts:

My challenge is this:

After downloading and installing the latest devtools, I try to run this code to install shinyapps and get the error message shown.

> devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinyapps")

And if I try to use R Studio to install shinyapps I get this message.

> install.packages("shinyapps")

(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning in install.packages :
  package ‘shinyapps’ is not available (for R version 3.1.1)


I also updated to the latest R (3.1.1)

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.1.1 (2014-07-10)

locale:

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
 [1] devtools_1.5   digest_0.6.4   evaluate_0.5.5 httr_0.3       memoise_0.2.1  parallel_3.1.1
 [7] RCurl_1.95-4.1 stringr_0.6.2  tools_3.1.1    whisker_0.3-2

Best regards, and thanks in advance.

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: shinyapps - can't seem to install
parts:
It can be a firewall issue. Downloading the zip package from Github
might have failed during devtools::install_github(). See if you are
able to download
https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/archive/master.zip If you can,
unzip it, and use

R CMD INSTALL shinyapps-master

to install it in a command window. Well, I do not know how much you
know about R CMD INSTALL...

Do not use utils:::menuInstallPkgs(). The zip package you downloaded
is not really a Windows binary package for R; it is just a normal zip
archive of the source package.

Regards,
Yihui
